# solidping_check (Resource)

A monitoring check (HTTP, TCP, DNS, heartbeat, ...).

The type-specific settings go in `config`, as a JSON object. Secrets (passwords, tokens, basic-auth credentials) go in `config_sensitive`: the API stores them encrypted and never returns them, so the provider keeps them in the state as written and never reports drift on them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An HTTP check, every minute, with basic authentication.
resource "solidping_check" "website" {
  name   = "Website"
  type   = "http"
  period = "00:01:00"

  config = jsonencode({
    url     = "https://www.acme.com/health"
    headers = { "Accept" = "application/json" }
  })

  # Secrets are stored encrypted by SolidPing and never read back.
  config_sensitive = jsonencode({
    basicAuth = "monitor:${var.monitor_password}"
  })

  labels = {
    env  = "prod"
    team = "web"
  }
}

# A TCP check pinned to two regions (the region slugs are those of your SolidPing server).
resource "solidping_check" "database" {
  name    = "Database port"
  type    = "tcp"
  regions = ["eu-west", "us-east"]

  config = jsonencode({
    host = "db.acme.com"
    port = 5432
  })
}

variable "monitor_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (String) Type-specific configuration, as a JSON object: `jsonencode({ url = "https://acme.com" })`. Only the keys written here are compared with the server, so defaults the server adds never show as drift.
- `type` (String) Check type: `http`, `tcp`, `icmp`, `dns`, `ssl`, `heartbeat`, `domain`, ... (the full list is in the SolidPing documentation). Changing it replaces the check.

### Optional

- `check_group_uid` (String) UID of the check group this check belongs to.
- `config_sensitive` (String, Sensitive) Secret configuration keys, as a JSON object merged over `config` when the check is written. Never read back from the server. Removing a key clears the stored secret.
- `description` (String) What this check monitors.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the check runs. Defaults to `true`.
- `escalation_policy_uid` (String) UID of the escalation policy assigned to this check. When omitted, the check inherits its group's policy, then the organization default.
- `labels` (Map of String) Key-value labels, used to filter checks and to feed status-page section selectors.
- `name` (String) Display name. Derived from the target by the server when omitted.
- `period` (String) Interval between two runs, as `HH:MM:SS` (e.g. `00:01:00`). Defaults to the server default (one minute).
- `placement` (String) `pinned` (the `regions` list never moves) or `auto` (the scheduler picks `region_count` healthy regions). Derived from `regions` when omitted.
- `region_count` (Number) Automatic placement only: how many regions run the check.
- `regions` (List of String) Region slugs the check runs from. Setting it pins the check to these regions. When omitted, the server places the check and this attribute reports the current placement.
- `slug` (String) URL-friendly identifier, unique in the organization. Derived by the server when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UID of the check.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A check is imported with `org/uid`.
terraform import solidping_check.website acme/0190f3a2-7c1d-7e3b-9a55-2f4f8a1b6c7d
```
